note: Times are IST. US releases are converted from US Eastern Time; US daylight saving runs {{fact:mac-us-dst-2026}} and {{fact:mac-us-dst-2027}}. Index expiries fall on {{fact:fo-nifty-weekly-expiry-day}} at NSE and {{fact:fo-sensex-weekly-expiry-day}} at BSE; a holiday on the expiry day moves expiry to the previous trading day. The cash pre-open order window is {{fact:mkt-preopen-window}}, closing at a random moment between 09:08 and 09:10. NSE's 2027 holiday list was not published as of {{date:2026-11-01}}.

events.what: NSE Nifty 50 weekly options expire (previous trading day if a holiday); short options expiring that day carry an extra {{fact:fo-expiry-day-elm-addon}} ELM
BSE Sensex weekly options expire (previous trading day if a holiday)
NSE monthly expiry on the {{fact:fo-monthly-expiry-day-nse}}: Nifty 50, Bank Nifty, FinNifty, Nifty Midcap Select, Nifty Next 50 and every stock future and option
BSE monthly expiry on the {{fact:fo-monthly-expiry-day-bse}}: Sensex, Bankex and stock derivatives
RBI Monetary Policy Committee, six meetings a year: the policy resolution and the Governor's statement come on the last day of each meeting; RBI publishes the next year's schedule around March
India CPI inflation (MoSPI); the next working day when the 12th is a holiday
India index of industrial production, IIP (MoSPI); the next working day when the 28th is a holiday
India GDP: quarterly estimates on MoSPI's advance-release dates at the end of February (Q3 with the advance estimates), May (Q4 with the provisional estimates), August and November

Nifty 50 and other NSE index reconstitutions take effect on the last trading day of March and September (semi-annual review on data to January and July; changes are announced about four weeks earlier)
Finance Ministry notifies small-savings rates (PPF, SCSS, NSC, Sukanya Samriddhi) for the next quarter on the last working day of March, June, September and December
EPFO's Central Board of Trustees recommends the EPF interest rate for the financial year ending
AMFI monthly mutual-fund data: SIP inflows, AUM and net flows for the previous month

US CPI (around the 10th to 14th) and the jobs report (usually the first Friday) are released at 08:30 ET, which is {{fact:mac-us-cpi-release-ist-dst}} under US daylight time ({{fact:mac-us-dst-2026}}; {{fact:mac-us-dst-2027}}) and {{fact:mac-us-cpi-release-ist-std}} otherwise

FOMC statement at 14:00 ET on the second meeting day: {{fact:mac-fomc-statement-ist-dst}} under EDT, {{fact:mac-fomc-statement-ist-std}} the next calendar day under EST; the press conference follows half an hour later; eight meetings a year, four with economic projections
Union Budget presented to Parliament (NSE and BSE hold a live session when it falls on a weekend)

Advance-tax instalments, cumulative: {{fact:tax-advance-tax-q1}}, {{fact:tax-advance-tax-q2}}, {{fact:tax-advance-tax-q3}}, {{fact:tax-advance-tax-q4}}; presumptive-scheme taxpayers: {{fact:tax-advance-tax-presumptive}} (Income-tax Act 2025 s. 408)

Income-tax return due dates: {{fact:tax-return-due-date-other}} for most individuals, {{fact:tax-return-due-date-business-noaudit}} with business income (intraday or F&O) and no audit, {{fact:tax-return-due-date-audit}} for audited persons (Income-tax Act 2025 s. 263)

Results seasons: quarterly results within {{fact:sebi-results-deadline-quarterly}} of quarter-end and audited annual results within {{fact:sebi-results-deadline-annual}} of year-end (LODR Reg 33) — roughly mid-Jan to mid-Feb, mid-Apr to end-May, mid-Jul to mid-Aug and mid-Oct to mid-Nov
